name: usage-limit
description: Keeps the account usage limit from running out mid-task: one subagent at a time from 90%, a commit of the work in progress at 97%, a pause that keeps the last 2% for you, and an automatic resume when the window resets.

reserve.title: Reserve (%)
reserve.description: Share of the usage limit kept for you. The session pauses at 100 minus this value.

alert.title: Alert (%)
alert.description: From this share of the usage limit, only one subagent runs at a time.

timeZone.title: Time zone
timeZone.description: IANA time zone for the times shown, such as America/New_York. Empty uses the system time zone.

commitAt.title: Commit from (%)
commitAt.description: From this share of the usage limit, the agent is asked once per window to commit its work in progress, without pushing. 0 turns it off.

resume.title: Resume when the window resets
resume.description: Resume the session on its own when the window resets, after the pause or after the limit error. Off, you resume it.

bandFrom.title: Band from (%)
bandFrom.description: Show the usage band above the prompt from this share of the usage limit.
